heading: What Our Patients Say About Arizona Biltmore Dentistry

items.quote: Wish I could award more then five stars to Arizona Biltmore Dentistry. Needing extensive work done on failed inplants, I devoted a lot of time into researching dentists in the Phoenix and Scottsdale area , fortunately I chose Dr Jeziorski. The work is extensive and complicated--he worked with me to find solutions--his manner is patient and kind and the work done on my mouth is beautiful. The tone of this office begins when you call and instead of just rattling off Arizona Biltmore Dentistry--they follow with "I can help you"--and that pretty much sets the tone for your experience. The absolute best dental technician i have ever had is Dr Jeziorski's---Ericka---through the whole process she is reassuring --so knowledgable--and personable. She was with me through the entire process--kept me informed --. Erika supports you and cares about your comfort. If you are on the fence about finding a new dental office, do yourself a favor and call the Arizona Biltmore Dentistry.
items.author: Kathy Holden P.

items.quote: I am about two months out from a dental cleaning and two crown placements and I couldn't have been luckier to schedule with and be care for by the team. 1st - Accessibility: they have longer hours of operation and better flexibility than any other dentistry office I found in the valley. They accepted me and scheduled me with a month to spare before my dental insurance ran out and got me in for my three billable appointments. Otherwise, my dental benefits would have gone to waste.2nd - Quality: the staff are extremely competent and careful about their work. They emphasized my comfort and whenever I felt the slightest bit of pain from my temp crowns, they would immediately bring me into a room without an appointment and a dental assistant would adjust it. This was never with a charge, just for courtesy and my own comfort.3rd - Kindness: I couldn't have been luckier to work with a more approachable, personable, and warm-spirited group of people.3a - Dentists: Dr. Jeziorski served me for me for my cleaning, first temp crown, and final crown placement - he was exceptionally professional and masterful of his work. I also had the pleasure of working with Dr. Leonard who might be the funniest and skillful individuals of her trade - I felt extremely lucky to have had her service since Dr. J couldn't see me. I would be more than happy to work with Dr. J or Dr. Leonard equally in the future and have the most confidence with either.3b - Hygienist: Each of the dental hygienist that care for me were also wonderful! Omar was there for my first appointment and Brittnie for my first cleaning and crown. Omar took his time to talk through treatment options, recommendations, and give me dental hygiene skills. Brittnie was very kind and efficient. She took exceptionally good care of me as I had my first ever crown placed. Annie was the third dental hygienist that I saw for my second crown placement. She isn't a permanent staff member (coming in as needed) but I wish she was! She took her time cleaning my teeth and prepping for the second crown and since there was some extra time before we got started with the procedure, she took advantage of it to help clean a strain in the front of my teeth that formed after a chip. This was above and beyond anything I could have asked for!3c - Dental Assistants: Jason and Zenovia were the two dental assistants that I spent the most time with. Jason care for me for my first evaluation and and first cleaning/temp crown placement, but even when I was with Zenovia he went out of his way to check on me and chat. He is extremely personable, talented, and enthusiastic. I hope to see him become a dentist himself someday because he has an undeniably golden character that is hard to come by. Zenovia completed my second cleaning/temp crown and the permanent crown placements. She, like Jason, was so kind and empathetic. I was confident in her abilities and she offered some of the kindest compliments I have received. I was also so fortunate to be care for by Nick for a quick drop in. I was having some tooth aches after my second temp crown and Nick quickly identified and corrected the issue to allow me to sleep pain free!3d - Front Desk: the leadership at this office did well to put together the front desk crew that they did. LC and Karla were not only approachable (as someone at the front desk should be) but they were enjoyable - I felt more eager to speak with them than to wait in silence to be called back. For one appointment, I came in an hour early on accident, and LC was more than happy to help me understand my charges and the dental benefits coverage. Her service was beyond exceptional. Karla is the reason that all of my scheduling was well accommodated and that any administrative questions were addressed. Every time I was getting ready to leave she greeted me with a warm smile that radiated beyond her mask and scheduled me for the best follow up appointment as needed. She was absolutely wonderful!I couldn't recommend the office more. I live out in Buckeye and work in Phoenix, but I wouldn't go anywhere else or in between. I trust this practice with everything I've got and am so happy with their transparency and warmth in a field that it can be hard to find sometimes. I encourage you to just stop by the front desk to ask about their services and you will see what I mean.
items.author: Yezan H.

items.quote: These guys are great. Had some tooth sensitivity and my normal dentist jacked up their self pay rate so I found AZ Biltmore dentistry on Yelp. The had an X-ray and cleaning special for $99 and got me in quick! Everyone was so nice, from the front office staff to the dentist himself. I'll definitely be back!
items.author: Andrew W.
